issue.description: Proposing bead: sase-1n6.5.1.5.2.1.2 note 12. Diagnose the descriptor/provider/flag state causing the files pane to vanish from the fixed prefix only in the broad lane; minimize an order-dependent reproducer before changing production or assertions. The only repair-under-test files were release.yml and qualification transport tests. Root cause is unproved; size large intentionally requests planning. This is distinct from the old duplicate-agents assertion fixed in 179508566/e5989fd28 and retired in the baseline: do not reopen sase-uf, sase-u6, or treat those as witnesses. Active sase-j7 is relevant tooling if a shared-state leak is proven, but no causal link is established yet. Preserve original check outcome. Evidence artifact contains check metadata/log, hashes and the unchanged-tree / clean-base probes.
